description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate in the Homagama, Maththegoda D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 52008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on property registration and title settlement processes for specific land parcels, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
